migrations.summary: Applied catalog expansion recommendations: sustainability, resilience, observability, caching, serialization, frontend/UI, RAG, prompts, agents, security efficiency, and richer rule metadata.
Formalized systems-level sustainability metadata fields in the rule schema and promoted the catalog expansion to a versioned 0.4.0 release.
migrations.compatibility: Backward compatible with 0.3.x rule files because additional rule properties remain allowed; new metadata fields now have documented shapes and validation constraints.
